:''This device is known as Connect Box, distributed by UPC (Liberty Global) within Europe.''
"P/N: 1417465200000" and "MODEL: CH7465CE" is silkscreened on the board (OEM: [[Arcadyan]])
The default SSID and credentials are printed on a sticker on the router's chassis. :The format is not known and will probably depend on the target market / rebrand type.
DOCSIS 3.0 24x8 ({{Approved by service|UPC}}) {{CableModemSpec |down_c=24 |up_c=8 }} *{{WiFiCert|WFA65642|13/05/2016}}
===Specifications=== *DOCSIS 3.0 and EuroDOCSIS 3.0 compliant, 24×8 channel bonding *2.4GHz and 5GHz radio for wireless 802.11abgn/ac connectivity *Wireless function supports Wi-Fi 2.4/5GHz Dual-band mode *Four 10/100/1000 Base-T Ethernet uplink ports *VoIP Internet telephone connections, Two RJ-11 voice ports *1GHz Full band capture, supports IPv4/IPv6, Low-power consumption
